answer_1.quote: We evaluate the pre-trained models on a set of reading comprehension tasks, namely RACE, SQuAD, HotpotQA, and the following retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) tasks: NQ, TQA, and Multi‑Document Question‑Answering (MDQA)... We also report exact match (EM) scores on closed‑book QA tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for QA tasks and predictions for classification/reading‑comprehension benchmarks
